answer: A dune is one fake identity. The ocean is the register of keys, and a key takes a berth only when judges certify its own record of one epoch of paid service for every key the ocean already holds; each certified epoch burns ferrous, which the chain mints at a fixed rate. A thousand dunes therefore need five hundred thousand epochs and five hundred thousand ferrous, where the first honest key needs one of each. No split of the fleet helps, and parallelising buys no time: judges certify a fixed number of records per epoch. It breaks if one owner holds the judges, or the ocean forks.
